headline: Labor informality affects mortgages and new home sales: Canadevi
summary: Lenders with more formal employment account for greater mortgage activity, according to Canadevi. In Mexico, self-construction with own resources predominates as the route to housing.
why: Mortgage access and new home sales drive demand in the housing and construction sectors, and they depend on formal employment levels. Canadevi is Mexico's national chamber of housing developers.
original_headline: Informalidad laboral afecta hipotecas y colocación de vivienda nueva: Canadevi
